benchmarks.note: Saved query 'YSE Magnitude-Limited Sample (min mag < 18.6)' on the personal dashboard (issue #204). Gating tier: test_mag_limited_query_regression seeds the dataset below and scales budgets linearly when YSE_PERF_MAG_LIMITED_TRANSIENTS is larger; each SELECT is capped server-side at the SQL budget. baseline_ms is compared unscaled against the gating tier (300 x 10); the test logs '<key>: <ms> ms' so it can be re-recorded from a CI run (see baseline_source). full_tier_reference_ms is the 3000 x 20 measurement from record_perf_benchmark (non-gating); the command warns when a full-tier run exceeds regression_factor times it.
benchmarks.baseline_source: GitHub Actions run 36518134636, job docker-test (PR #207, first gating-tier run that printed timings): 1345.2 / 2500.1 / 1130.1 ms, rounded up with headroom

full_tier.baseline_source: GitHub Actions run 36517297730 (first full-tier record_perf_benchmark after PR #206): 188.8 / 390.5 / 203.0 ms, rounded up
full_tier.note: Reference for entries.*.full_tier_reference_ms. Scaled linearly like max_ms when YSE_PERF_MAG_LIMITED_TRANSIENTS is above 3000.

mag_limited_sample_sql.note: Raw SQL via the dashboard cursor path, also the max_execution_time cap. Production budget is 60 s at ~300x this volume; a good plan runs this in well under a second, a per-candidate-row dependent-subquery plan takes tens of seconds.

personal_dashboard_mag_limited_cold.note: /personaldashboard/section/<id>/ with empty result cache: SQL + Transient table build + render.

personal_dashboard_mag_limited_warm.note: Same fragment with the SQL result cached (1 h TTL in the view); table build + render only.

search_acceptance_sql.note: Issue #286 acceptance search (|b| > 10, peak_mag < 19, num_det >= 3, last detection within 5 d) as the FilterSet queryset over Transient + TransientPhotStat, gating tier 2000 transients (test_search_perf_regression; YSE_PERF_SEARCH_TRANSIENTS overrides). Not scaled with the size: the gal_b / stat-row indexes must keep it flat; the criterion is under 1 s at production volume.

search_acceptance_page.note: GET /search/ with the same parameters: the query, the paginator COUNT, the form's choice lists and the table render.
